members.name: QwikRouterVitePluginOptions
members.content:
```typescript export interface QwikRouterVitePluginOptions extends Omit ``` **Extends:** Omit<PluginOptions, 'basePathname'>
Property Modifiers Type Description
devSsrServer? boolean _(Optional)_ Qwik is an SSR first framework. This means that Qwik requires either SSR or SSG. In Vite dev mode the dev SSR server is responsible for rendering and pausing the application on the server. Under normal circumstances this should be on, unless you have your own dev SSR server setup and wish to disable this one. Default: true
imageOptimization? ImageOptimizationOptions _(Optional)_
mdx? [MdxOptions](#mdxoptions) _(Optional)_
mdxPlugins? MdxPlugins _(Optional)_
platform? Record<string, unknown> _(Optional)_
ssrCacheSize? number _(Optional)_ Maximum number of SSR-rendered pages to keep in the in-memory cache. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 50
staticImportRoutes? boolean _(Optional)_ Whether to use static imports for route modules (layout and index files). Defaults to `false`.
